subject: GCP catalog / co-sell: assemble SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for Northstar
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP catalog / co-sell: assemble SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for Northstar

Team —

Northstar Logistics (prospect) is ready to move our GCP catalog listing into their internal procurement review. Amanda (GCP partner manager) flagged that for the co-sell listing and the Marketplace security audit we need the following artifacts attached or accessible to their security reviewers:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Executive pen-test summary (redacted findings ok)
- Signed DPA (their legal wants our current template)

Can we compile an evidence bundle and a short cover note that explains redaction/controls and where the full evidence can be accessed? Procurement wants the bundle by COB Monday 03/23.

Ideal split of work: Sergio — can you confirm latest SOC2 PDF and whether we can share it via secure Drive link? Karthik — please update the pen-test summary and confirm redaction status. Lauren — can you coordinate the DPA/DocuSign link and note any outstanding clauses they commonly ask to negotiate for GCP catalog deals? Vanessa — I may need you to review the cover note for compliance phrasing.

I'll loop Amanda and David (Northstar procurement) once we have the bundle ready. Thanks — short and focused please.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP catalog / co-sell: assemble SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for Northstar

On Sat, Mar 21, 2026 at 8:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Northstar Logistics (prospect) is ready to move our GCP catalog listing into their internal procurement review. Amanda (GCP partner manager) flagged that for the co-sell listing and the Marketplace security audit we need the following artifacts attached or accessible to their security reviewers:
>
> - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
> - Executive pen-test summary (redacted findings ok)
> - Signed DPA (their legal wants our current template)
>
> Can we compile an evidence bundle and a short cover note that explains redaction/controls and where the full evidence can be accessed? Procurement wants the bundle by COB Monday 03/23.

I've pulled the SOC2 Type II PDF (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf). It's the full report, but per typical policy we must share via secure link and require an NDA for the underlying workpapers. For the GCP catalog public listing they only need the report and a one-paragraph controls summary. For Northstar's procurement review we'll provide the full PDF behind our secure Drive and a short note about redaction of customer identifiers.

I attached the following (stubs below) and will upload originals to the secure drive folder and set viewer-only access:
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (full report, redacted customer names)
- PenTest_Executive_Summary_2026.txt (one-page executive summary)

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: PenTest_Executive_Summary_2026.txt (text/plain)

I will not send full pen-test raw data; only the executive summary and mitigations map. Karthik, ping me if you need access to the SOC artifacts to update the summary.

— Sergio
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Huang <amanda.huang@gcp-partner.google.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Chen <procurement@northstarlogistics.com>, marketplace-security@gcp-partner.google.com
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP catalog / co-sell: assemble SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for Northstar

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the heads up and for coordinating. Quick clarifications from GCP side:

1) For the public catalog listing we need the SOC2 cover and the controls summary.
2) For Northstar's procurement review, they may request the executive pen-test summary and a DPA in our standard format. If they require in-depth raw test artifacts, GCP will ask for a SOC2 workpaper review agreement (we can facilitate).
3) DPA: we accept DocuSign copies. If Redwood has an in-house DPA template, we can route through our legal to confirm redlines for co-sell.

Please send the Drive link to marketplace-security and to David at Northstar with viewer-only access and the following note: what is redacted and why, who to contact for a secure walkthrough, and expected timelines.

Amanda Huang
Partner Manager, GCP Marketplace

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Huang <amanda.huang@gcp-partner.google.com>, David Chen <procurement@northstarlogistics.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP catalog / co-sell: assemble SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for Northstar

Amanda / David —

Thanks — attaching the evidence bundle summary and a secure link below. Per Sergio: the SOC2 PDF is redacted to remove third-party customer identifiers; the pen-test file is an executive summary with mitigations. If you need a walkthrough of the artifacts, Sergio can set up a 30-minute call and grant time-limited access to the underlying workpapers after an NDA.

Evidence bundle (viewer-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSECURE-evidence
DocuSign DPA (click to sign): https://www.docusign.com/en/rdw/RDW-DPA-v1.2

Attachments included in Drive: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (pdf, redacted), PenTest_Executive_Summary_2026.txt (text)

Next steps:
- David: can you confirm whether Northstar prefers a signed DPA or a mutual redline?
- Amanda: please confirm if marketplace-security needs additional logs/artifacts for the catalog listing; otherwise we consider this bundle complete for GCP catalog + procurement review.

Thanks everyone — will follow up with the timeline for the NDA/workpaper access if requested.

— Soojin
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
